prompt2:
You are given a positive integer N and an integer sequence A = (A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N) of length N.
Determine whether there exists a non-empty subarray of A that has a repeated value. If such a subarray exists, find the length of the shortest such subarray.
Input
The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:
N
A_1 A_2 \dots A_N
Output
If there is no subarray satisfying the condition in the problem statement, print -1. Otherwise, print the length of the shortest such subarray.
Constraints
- 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5
- 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^6 \ (1 \leq i \leq N)
- All input values are integers.

Clarification: Refer to the problem statement for specifications related to: Does a subarray count as a contiguous segment of t...

Clarification: A subarray of length 1 cannot have a repeated value, so it does not satisfy the condition.
